prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high in four of the five rounds, though round 5 was slightly under-predicted.
Sign-in reorder changes are helpful, averaging +2.7% after noise correction across three tests, with two winning tests and one showing no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Evidence is still thin for sign-in copy changes, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, copy: -0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.7% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Adoption Spotlight Showcase: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a spotlight layout to highlight pet personalities clearly. (why: Adoption has a 60.9% drop-off and high median time (89s), showing users need a clearer choice experience.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Custom Trait Screen: Adds a dedicated preview screen right after choosing a friend to set initial pet traits before upload. (why: Custom pet generation fails or looks wrong for several users in support emails, so clarifying traits earlier reduces adoption drop-off.)
2: [home, new_flow] Real-Time Pet Generation Flow: Rebuilds the waiting screen into a dynamic step-by-step checklist showing live generation progress. (why: The home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off due to perceived stalling.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Orientation Split View: Redesigns the final intro screen into a split view showing how the pet behaves on the desktop. (why: The finish step drops to 64.8% completion and support received emails about pets missing on desktop or unclear controls.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Status Notification Alert: Adds explicit notification opt-in and time estimates on the waiting screen so users know when generation finishes. (why: Users wait a median of 201s (mean 2336s) during home step, and support reported app stalling concerns.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Safeguard Copy: Updates sign-in screen text to emphasize that signing in protects pet save states across devices and sessions. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity Guidance: Adds photo preparation instructions on the upload screen to improve custom pet rendering quality. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Onboarding Path Choice Split View: Changes the path selection layout to a side-by-side split comparison of preset versus custom pet creation. (why: Choose path takes a median of 8s (mean 514s) with a 76.2% conversion rate.)
8: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Official Seal: Adds an official adoption seal badge component onto the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption completion rate is low (60.9%), and celebratory milestones increase emotional connection and completion.)
9: [finish, notification] Desktop Quick Help Toast Hint: Triggers a helpful hint toast shortly after entering home intro explaining how to reveal desktop controls. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or interact with pets after onboarding.)
